faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do I find a venue near me?
faq.a1: Enter your city in the search bar. Directory Template shows the closest venues with schedules, prices and reviews.
faq.a2: Yes, completely. Search and compare venues without signing up or paying anything.
faq.a3: Fitness, yoga, spa, strength training and many more. The category list adapts to your directory.
faq.q4: How do I list my venue on Directory Template?
faq.a4: Create a free account and claim or add your venue. You can update schedules, prices and photos anytime.
faq.a5: Reviews are posted by verified members. We monitor reports to ensure reliable, trustworthy feedback.

where.q: Where can I practice {category} near me?
where.a: Use the cities below to open the list of {category} venues in your city. Each venue page shows the address and how to get in touch.

price.q: How much does a {category} venue cost?
price.a: Prices vary by city and membership. Most venues offer a free or low-cost trial class. Ask the venue directly for the current fees.

kids.a: Many venues run kids' classes. Check the minimum age and schedule on the venue page, or contact the venue before you sign up.

trial.q: How do I book a {category} trial class?
trial.a: Open a venue page, contact them, and ask for a trial. Most studios offer a first class free or at a low price.

licence.q: Do I need a licence to practice {category}?
licence.a: Often yes, through the network the venue belongs to. Ask what the membership includes (licence, insurance, class access) before you commit.

cityPage.chooseLocationBody: Pick a venue close to home or work. A short commute is the difference between going and skipping.
cityPage.chooseVisitBody: Contact the venue, watch a class, talk to the staff. The venue page has the website and phone when we have them.
cityPage.chooseStyleBody: Confirm the venue actually offers {category} — not only a related activity. Activities are listed on each venue page.

start.a: Yes — most venues take new members year-round. Confirm the details directly with the venue.

level.q: Are there beginner or kids classes?
level.a: It depends on the venue. We don't have that data yet: open the venue page and ask about levels and age groups.

licence.q: Do I need a licence to practice?
licence.a: Often yes, through the network the venue belongs to. Ask what is included when you sign up.

area.q: How do I choose a neighborhood in {city}?
area.a: Use the postal-code filter above. In Paris, each 75xxx code maps to an arrondissement. Pick a venue you can reach consistently.

price.q: How much does a {category} class cost in {city}?
price.a: Most venues offer a free or cheap trial session. Expect roughly €10–20 per class, or a monthly membership depending on the venue. Exact prices are on each venue page.

equipment.q: What equipment do I need to start {category} in {city}?
equipment.a: For your first classes, sportswear is enough at most venues. Specific gear (mats, towels, small equipment) is usually lent to beginners, then bought later depending on the activity.
